card.name: Partway through long drug-interaction words
card.fires_on: Fires on a middle or ending piece of a long medical word, often one that starts a drug-interaction term such as ketoconazole, cimetidine, concomitantly, inducers, or Child-Pugh. It is seen in drug-interaction and lab-test passages.

modes.label: Inside interacting drug names
modes.description: Partway through names of enzyme-affecting drugs like ketoconazole and cimetidine.
